summary.headline: Scorpio and Sagittarius Birth Prognoses
summary.text: Astrological prognoses for men and women born under Scorpio, covering illness, character, marriage, livelihood, lifespan, and ritual cures invoking Saint Nicholas and Saint Marina; the Sagittarius prediction begins with family, temperament, health, craft, litigation, and fortune.
